svg.title: Cloud resources and connectivity
svg.desc:
Cloud resources and connectivity Large resource icons inside account, network and subnet enclosures. Solid lines: service connectivity.
Blocks, left to right: - Public API (Amazon API Gateway) - Application function (VPC-connected Lambda) - Application database (Amazon RDS) - Object storage (Amazon S3) Groups: - Application subnet: Application function - Database subnet: Application database - VPC: Application function, Application database - AWS account: Public API, Application function, Application database, Object storage Lines: - Public API -> Application function, labeled "invoke" - Application function -> Application database, labeled "SQL" - Application function -> Object storage, labeled "objects" Note: Illustrative workload. Fictional account; no deployed resources Border styles are independently selectable
